description:
Build a throwaway spike on a branch, not merged, or merged under website/ only with no required CI. Scope:
- landing hero
- docs/usage/getting-started.md converted from MyST
- the blog post 2026-05-18-v0-3-0-release-overview at its current .html URL
- the existing results-explorer dist copied to /results/
- shared header and dark mode using the same localStorage key benchbox:theme
- Pagefind search over the sample

Build it twice, with custom layouts and with Starlight, so the layout choice rests on evidence.

Measure on the same CI runner class: build time vs the current docs-build step, HTML+JS bytes per sample page vs Sphinx, axe results, and whether the exact current URLs are produced.

Write _project/decisions/astro-spike-report.md with the numbers and a go/no-go recommendation.
